notablePrerequisites: You control a creature whose toughness is equal to one.
description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature whose toughness is equal to one.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Skullclamp triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate an Insect by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
